## Design

### 2026-10-10 – The stuff i worked on:

**2.5h**

The stuff i worked on:
-the schematic
-the placement on pcb
-the 3d models for the keys
The problems i faced:
-I was trying to automatically arrange the keys but it kept getting messed up and it turned out that i had some settings wrong and that 2 of the buttons where upside down for some reason and that caused them to be out of place.
-The keys didnt have any 3d model so it took me a while to find a 3d model of a 3 pin keyboard switch and then it also turned out that i needed to manually assign and arrange the 3d models on each key and that was annoying.

Coding session:
So it was pretty easy overall, I didnt really face any problems.
Since I already knew some python it wasnt that hard I searched up a few stuff on python circuit and also asked ai for some help but overall it went pretty smooth and didnt take too long.

The features I added:
-every button activates a shortcut and its also pretty easy to costumize
-The screen shows the time and I needed to use the pi pico's internal clock so you need to setup the time manually at first
-the screen shows what shortcut you used when you press a button then goes back to showing the time
